proof_body:
by
  intro F u U hU hu hd hb
  have hlu := Summable.hasProdLocallyUniformlyOn_nat_one_add hU hu (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hb) (fun n => (hd n).continuousOn)
  refine ⟨fun z hz => hlu.hasProd hz, ?_⟩
  have ht := hlu.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn_finsetRange
  refine ht.differentiableOn (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun n => ?_)) hU
  exact DifferentiableOn.fun_finset_prod (fun i _ => (differentiableOn_const 1).add (hd i))
target_source: ∀ (F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (U : Set ℂ), IsOpen U → Summable u → (∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) U) → (∀ n, ∀ z ∈ U, ‖F n z‖ ≤ u n) → (∀ z ∈ U, HasProd (fun n => 1 + F n z) (∏' n, (1 + F n z))) ∧ DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => ∏' n, (1 + F n z)) U
